ngaap.guidance: 2023 guidance unchanged (27-Apr-2023): Revenue $17.4B - $17.8B; segment operating income $2.7B - $2.8B; segment operating margin 15.2% - 15.7%; non-GAAP EPS $12.00 - $12.50; adjusted free cash flow $2.0B+ (net of ~$400M - $500M anticipated R&D-related tax payments); second-half weighted EPS and FCF. By segment: IMS revenue $6.5B - $6.7B (2022 recast $6.6B), operating income $800M - $850M (2022 GAAP $494M / non-GAAP $861M recast); SAS $6.4B - $6.5B ($6.4B), $700M - $750M ($665M / $745M); CS $4.8B - $4.9B ($4.2B), $1,150M - $1,200M ($667M / $1,022M). Other: FAS/CAS pension adjustment, net ~$375M (FAS pension service cost ~(25), CAS pension cost ~(100), FAS/CAS operating adjustment ~75, non-service FAS pension income ~300); net interest expense ~$400M; acquisition-related transaction and integration expenses ~$100M; L3Harris merger-related integration expenses ~$0; non-GAAP effective tax rate 13% - 14%; average diluted shares ~191M; capex ~$275M.
ngaap.notes: 2023 basis: 'Segment operating income' in the tables is GAAP segment operating income; 'Non-GAAP segment operating income' excludes segment-level impairment charges. Non-GAAP EPS = EPS (no discontinued operations in 2023) plus the after-tax adjustments listed: amortization of acquisition-related intangibles; additional cost of sales related to the fair value step-up in inventory sold (TDL, new 1Q23); L3Harris merger-related integration expenses (2022 only); acquisition-related transaction and integration expenses (TDL, AJRD); pre-acquisition and other divestiture-related expenses; business divestiture-related gains; impairment of other assets; and the enterprise transformation program, renamed LHX NeXt in 2Q23 (new 1Q23). Pension (FAS/CAS operating adjustment, non-service FAS pension income) is NOT excluded. Adjusted free cash flow = operating cash flow less capex (net of proceeds) plus cash used for merger / acquisition-related transaction and integration costs. The FCF bridge in the release is the quarter column; cf in this file is year to date. 1Q23 adjustments: amortization 165, inventory step-up 15, acquisition-related transaction and integration 40, pre-acquisition and other divestiture-related 10, impairment of other assets 18, enterprise transformation program 13 (first quarter of this item); income taxes on adjustments (51); total after tax 210. Prior-year non-GAAP EPS shown as $3.14 (originally $3.12): prior-year adjustments now 177 pre-tax (amortization 152, merger integration 24, pre-acquisition and other divestiture-related 1) vs 174 originally. Net debt / adjusted EBITDA 2.4x. No adjusted EBIT published (GAAP EBIT 475, 10.6%).
